preconditions.description: The shop starts with an empty cart and no orders

Intent.statement: A shopper can check out with the SAVE10 code and get an order with 10% off
success: An order is recorded with code SAVE10
The order total is 90% of its subtotal
failure: The order is charged the full subtotal

evidence.description: The last order has code SAVE10 and a total of 90% of its subtotal

Guardrails.rule: Never charge the live payments API; pay only through the test payments API

Execution.step: Add the Field Guide to the cart
Open checkout and apply the discount code SAVE10
Pay with the test card and wait for the order confirmation
